description_en: Modifies the specifications of an ApsaraDB Tair (Redis OSS-Compatible) instance
description_zh: 变更云数据库 Tair（兼容 Redis）实例的规格
name: ModifyInstanceSpec

parameters.help_en: The region ID. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/473763.html operation to query the region ID. Use this parameter to specify the region of the instance that you want to modify
parameters.help_zh: 地域ID，可调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/473763.html查询，使用此参数指定要变更实例的地域
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The instance ID. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/473778.html operation to obtain the instance ID
parameters.help_zh: 实例ID，可调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/473778.html获取
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The instance type code after the modification. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/473765.html operation to query the instance types available for modification in the zone to which the instance belongs.

For more information about instance types, refer to https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/26350.html
parameters.help_zh:
变更后的实例规格代码，您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/473765.html查询实例所属的可用区可以变配的规格。

各规格的详情，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/26350.html
parameters.name: instance_class

parameters.help_en: The activity ID and business information
parameters.help_zh: 活动ID、业务信息
parameters.name: business_info

parameters.help_en: The coupon code. Default value: `youhuiquan_promotion_option_id_for_blank`
parameters.help_zh: 优惠码，默认值：`youhuiquan_promotion_option_id_for_blank`
parameters.name: coupon_no

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to forcibly modify the specifications. Valid values:
false: No.
true: Yes. This is the default value
parameters.help_zh:
是否强制变配，取值：
false：不强制变配。
true：强制变配，默认值
parameters.name: force_upgrade

parameters.help_en:
The time when the modification takes effect. Valid values:
Immediately: The modification takes effect immediately. This is the default value.
MaintainTime: The modification takes effect during the maintenance window of the instance. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/473775.html operation to modify the maintenance window
parameters.help_zh:
变更执行时间，取值：
Immediately：立即执行，默认值。
MaintainTime：在实例的可维护时间段执行，您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/473775.html修改可维护时间段
parameters.name: effective_time

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable automatic payment. Valid values:
true: Automatic payment is enabled. This is the default value.
false: Manual payment is enabled. If this parameter is set to false, you must manually renew the instance in the console before the instance expires. For more information, refer to https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/26352.html
parameters.help_zh:
是否自动付款，取值：
true：自动付款，默认值。
false：手动付款。取值为false时，您需要在实例到期前通过控制台手动续费，详情请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/26352.html
parameters.name: auto_pay

parameters.help_en:
The modification type. This parameter is required when you modify the specifications of a subscription instance. Valid values:

UPGRADE: Upgrades the configurations. This is the default value.
DOWNGRADE: Downgrades the configurations.

When you downgrade the configurations of a subscription instance, you must set this parameter to DOWNGRADE.
If the price of the target instance type is higher than that of the current instance type, the configurations are upgraded. Otherwise, the configurations are downgraded. For example, the price of the 8 GB read/write splitting edition (5 read-only nodes) is higher than that of the 16 GB cluster edition. Changing the instance type from the latter to the former is considered an upgrade
parameters.help_zh:
变配类型，包年包月实例变配时需要传入本参数，取值：

UPGRADE：升级配置，默认值。
DOWNGRADE：降级配置。

包年包月实例降级配置时必须将该参数的值设置为DOWNGRADE。
如果变配的目标规格比现有规格的价格高，则为升级配置，反之为降级配置。例如，读写分离8G版（5只读节点）的价格比16G集群版的价格高，从后者变配到前者为升级配置
parameters.name: order_type

parameters.help_en:
The major engine version to which you want to upgrade a classic instance. Valid values: 2.8, 4.0, and 5.0.
When you upgrade the major engine version, the InstanceClass parameter is required. This indicates that this operation only supports upgrading the major engine version when you update the instance specifications. If you only need to upgrade the major engine version, call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/473776.html operation
parameters.help_zh:
适用于经典版实例升级的实例大版本，取值：2.8、4.0或5.0。
升级版本时InstanceClass参数为必填，表示本接口仅支持在更新实例规格时升级版本。若您仅需升级实例版本，请调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/473776.html
parameters.name: major_version

parameters.help_en: The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. You can use the client to generate the value, but you must ensure that it is unique among different requests. The token can contain only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 用于保证请求的幂等性。由客户端生成该参数值，要保证在不同请求间唯一，最大值不超过64个ASCII字符，且该参数值中不能包含非ASCII字符
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en: The source of the call. This parameter is used only for internal maintenance and does not need to be specified
parameters.help_zh: 调用来源，本参数仅用于内部维护使用，无需传入
parameters.name: source_biz

parameters.help_en:
The number of shards. This parameter applies only to cloud-native cluster instances. You can use this parameter to specify a custom number of shards.


To change a cloud-native cluster instance to a standard instance, you must explicitly set ShardCount to 1 and specify a standard instance type.
To change a cloud-native standard instance to a cluster instance, you must explicitly set ShardCount to a value greater than 1 and specify a cluster instance type
parameters.help_zh:
分片数，本参数仅适用于云原生版集群架构实例，您可以通过该参数实现自定义分片数量。


如果要从云原生版集群架构实例变配到标准架构 ，ShardCount 需要显式传 1，并且规格传标准规格。
如果要从云原生版标准架构实例变配到集群架构，ShardCount 需要显式传大于1的值，并且规格传集群规格
parameters.name: shard_count

parameters.help_en:
The number of secondary nodes in the primary zone. This parameter applies only to cloud-native multi-replica cluster instances. You can use this parameter to specify a custom number of secondary nodes. Valid values: 1 to 4.

If the instance is deployed across multiple zones, you can use this parameter and the SlaveReplicaCount parameter to specify the number of secondary nodes in the primary and secondary zones. The sum of this parameter and the SlaveReplicaCount parameter cannot exceed 4
parameters.help_zh:
主可用区的备节点数量，本参数仅适用于云原生版集群多副本实例，您可以通过该参数实现自定义备节点数量，取值：1~4。

若实例为多可用区实例，您可以通过该参数与SlaveReplicaCount参数自定义主、备可用区的备节点数量。同时，该参数与SlaveReplicaCount参数的总和不能超过4
parameters.name: replica_count

parameters.help_en: The number of secondary nodes in the secondary zone
parameters.help_zh: 备可用区的备节点数量
parameters.name: slave_replica_count

parameters.help_en:
The number of read-only nodes in the primary zone. This parameter applies only when you create a cloud-native read/write splitting instance.
If the instance uses the standard architecture, valid values are 0 to 9. A value of 0 indicates the shutdown of read/write splitting and an instance switchover to the standard architecture.
If the instance uses the cluster architecture, valid values are 1 to 4, which indicates the number of read-only nodes per shard.
If you create a multi-zone instance, you can use this parameter and the SlaveReadOnlyCount parameter to specify the number of read-only nodes in the primary and secondary zones.
If the instance uses the standard architecture, the sum of this parameter and SlaveReadOnlyCount cannot be greater than 9.
If the instance uses the cluster architecture, the sum of this parameter and SlaveReadOnlyCount cannot be greater than 4
parameters.help_zh:
主可用区的只读节点数，本参数仅适用于创建云原生读写分离实例。
若实例为标准架构，取值为0-9，0表示关闭读写分离，将实例切换为标准架构。
若实例为集群架构，取值为1-4，表示每数据分片的只读节点数。
若创建多可用区实例，您可以通过该参数和SlaveReadOnlyCount参数自定义主备可用区的只读节点数量。
若实例为标准架构，该参数与SlaveReadOnlyCount的总和不能大于9。
若实例为集群架构，该参数与SlaveReadOnlyCount的总和不能大于4
parameters.name: read_only_count

parameters.help_en: The number of read-only nodes in the secondary zone
parameters.help_zh: 备可用区的只读节点数量
parameters.name: slave_read_only_count

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable forced transmission. Valid values:
false (default): Before the specification change, the system checks the current minor engine version of the instance. If the minor engine version is too low, an error is reported. You must upgrade the minor engine version and retry.
true: The check is skipped, and the system directly executes the specification change
parameters.help_zh:
是否开启强制传输，取值：
false（默认）：在变配前，系统会检查实例当前的内核小版本，若内核版本过低则会报错，您需要升级内核小版本后重试。
true：跳过检查项，直接执行变配操作
parameters.name: force_trans

parameters.help_en:
The node type. Valid values:
MASTER_SLAVE: high-availability (dual-replica)
STAND_ALONE: single-replica
double: dual-replica
single: single-replica
Select MASTER_SLAVE or STAND_ALONE for cloud-native instances, and select double or single for classic instances
parameters.help_zh:
节点类型，取值：
MASTER_SLAVE：高可用（双副本）
STAND_ALONE：单副本
double：双副本
single：单副本
云原生版实例请选择MASTER_SLAVE或STAND_ALONE，经典版实例请选择double或single
parameters.name: node_type

parameters.help_en:
The storage type. Valid values: essd_pl1, essd_pl2, and essd_pl3.
This parameter is required only when InstanceType is set to tair_essd and the instance is a Tair ESSD instance
parameters.help_zh:
存储类型，取值为essd_pl1、essd_pl2、essd_pl3。
当InstanceType取值为tair_essd时，且实例为Tair磁盘ESSD型时，才需要输入本参数
parameters.name: storage_type

parameters.help_en:
The storage capacity of the disk instance. The value range varies based on the instance type. For more information, refer to https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2527111.html.
This parameter is required only when InstanceType is set to tair_essd and you create a Tair ESSD instance. When you create a Tair SSD instance, the capacity field is defined as different fixed values based on different instance types, and you do not need to specify this field
parameters.help_zh:
磁盘型实例的存储空间，不同的规格取值范围有所区别，详情请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2527111.html。
当InstanceType取值为tair_essd时，且创建Tair磁盘ESSD型时，才需要输入本参数。对于创建 Tair磁盘SSD型实例，容量字段按不同的规格定义为不同的固定值，无需指定该字段
parameters.name: storage

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the secondary zone. This parameter is required when you modify the specifications of a single-zone instance and migrate it to multiple zones. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/473764.html operation to query the zone ID.
The value of this parameter cannot be the same as the value of the ZoneId parameter, and you cannot specify the ID of a multi-zone deployment
parameters.help_zh:
当单可用区实例需要变配并迁移至多可用区时，必须指定备可用区 ID。可调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/473764.html接口查询。
本参数和ZoneId参数传入的值不能相同，且不可传入多可用区对应的ID
parameters.name: secondary_zone_id
